ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: SW — Bestiary
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description: MLIE_FAUNA_ABSORPTION_1 — absorbs content from `mlie.starwarsanimalcollection` (Star Wars Animal Collection) under an `RSW_` prefix, staged in waves. All 589 SoundDefs absorbed (per-creature Angry/Wounded/Death/Call vocal sets across 143+ creatures, plus ability sounds). Wave A creature geometry (Bantha ThingDef/PawnKindDef, wool/milk/leather/meat/horn items, blue-milk thought) is absorbed; Sarlacc was found not to be a creature at all (an Odyssey-DLC building system) and is out of this item's scope. Waves B/C (remaining species) are still open.
